task_description: Fix the NullPointerException in AddressLabel.render: a null Address or null Integer zip must return "ZIP unknown". For a present zip, return "ZIP " followed by its decimal value without zero padding. Preserve the Address record and run the unchanged Maven tests.

Fix the ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in TailPicker.last: a non-null empty integer array must return -1 and a nonempty array must return its last element. Preserve zero and negative values and run the unchanged Maven tests.

Fix the NumberFormatException and range handling in PortParser.parse: trimmed integer strings in the inclusive range 1 through 65535 must return that port. Null, blank, malformed, out-of-int-range and out-of-port-range inputs must return the default port 8080. Run the unchanged Maven tests.
